400.description: Validation failed or a business rule was broken; `message` says what to change.

401.description: No session, or it has expired: sign in again.

403.description: The caller's role, Team rights or ownership don't allow it, the module is switched off, or their access was removed.

404.description: No such record in this business.

409.description: The same Idempotency-Key is still being handled, or the record conflicts with one that exists.

429.description: Too many requests: wait a minute.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server; the response carries the request id to report.

  -H "Cookie: better-auth.session_token=<session>" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{ … }'

info.title: Spine API
info.description: The REST API behind Spine's web app and field app. Every route is under /api on your Spine's address.

signatureFileId.description: File id already uploaded via POST /files.

signerName.description: US-QUO-19 — the name the customer typed above their signature.

comment.description: The customer's reason, if they gave one.

userId.description: The user id to assign to this job's crew.

photoFileIds.description: File ids already uploaded via POST /files.

fileId.description: File id already uploaded via POST /files.

reason.description: Required when an Owner deletes a locked photo (job Completed or Cancelled, or its milestone invoiced); kept in the job's activity.

amount.description: Integer minor units, as a numeric string.

taxAmount.description: Integer minor units, as a numeric string. Defaults to 0.

receiptFileId.description: A file this person uploaded via POST /files that nothing else uses yet (D-250).
